sites.downstream: returned label string selects one of 10 insurance support categories
sites.reason: bounded semantic classification over trusted benign text into a closed enumerated set; no math, dates, multi-hop reasoning, generation, or adversarial input
sites.untrusted_input_mitigation: benign fixed dataset; scoped to this distribution

options.benefit: accepted Jev decisions are faster (~100 ms vs ~500+ ms) and cheaper ($0.042/M tokens input-only vs Haiku pricing); serial misses add Jev latency and cost before original inference
options.risk: Jev may disagree on ambiguous boundary cases between similar categories; conservative fallback retains original for low-confidence answers
options.scope: replace simple_classify entry point with classify that calls Jev Choice gated on confidence >= 0.7, falling back to original simple_classify on low confidence, missing key, errors, or timeouts
